entries.en: The population is under quarantine while the effects of the dark matter petrification are investigated.

entries.zh: 行星上到处都散布着暗物质固化形成的石化躯体。这些人口的残余物提供了一些研究机会。
entries.en: Petrified husks of solidified Dark Matter can be found scattered throughout the planet. These grim remnants of a former populus provide some amount of research opportunity.

entries.zh: 曾经被外星种族用作墓地的浓密云层现在正在变薄，云坟墓的内容物被倾倒到行星表面。
entries.en: Dense clouds that were once used as a burial site by an alien race are now thinning, sending the cloud graves' contents tumbling to the planetary surface.

entries.zh: 该行星的动物神秘又恶心。不建议接近这些生物。
entries.en: The animals of this planet are fascinating but disgusting. Close proximity to these creatures is not recommended.

entries.zh: 一种温顺的本地动物为行星上的人们提供娱乐和可收获的气体分泌物。
entries.en: A domesticated species of native fauna provide both entertainment and harvestable gas secretions for the planetary population.

entries.zh: 在方争端中站在城市一边，让乡野地区深感不安。
entries.en: Taking the side of urban districts in a local dispute has set the rural districts on edge.

entries.zh: 在方争端中站在乡野一边，让城市地区深感不安。
entries.en: Taking the side of rural districts in a local dispute has set the urban districts on edge.

entries.zh: 在解决这场区域争端中付诸额外的维和力量。
entries.en: Additional peacekeeping efforts are in effect while we resolve the district disputes.

entries.zh: 向供水中注入转基因细菌补充剂激发了人们对一个共同目标的非凡向往
entries.en: Water supplies infused with genetically-modified bacterial supplements inspire the population's exceptional commitment to a singular common goal

entries.zh: 随着这个饱受战争蹂躏的世界开始重建，对他们而言越来越严重的偏执使得与他人的互动变成了双方的挑战。
entries.en: As this war torn world rebuilds, their increased paranoia makes interactions with others a challenge for everyone involved.

entries.zh: 活体金属巨构工程洞见
我们取回的活体金属文物带给了我们关于巨构工程发展的难以置信的洞见。
entries.en: The Living Metal artifact we recovered has delivered to us incredible insight on developing megastructures.

entries.zh: 活体金属巨构工程法令基础花费：§G-50%§!
entries.en: Living Metal Mega-Construction Edict base cost: §G-50%§!

entries.zh: 一种粘稠的液体从行星表面喷涌而出，凝结成一种几乎无法穿透的危险物质。这样一来可供安全建造的空间就很少了。
entries.en: A viscous ooze pulses out of the planetary surface, congealing to form a nearly impenetrable hazardous material. This leaves little space in which to build safely.

entries.zh: 一座来历不明的巨大而闪亮的建筑。
entries.en: A large, shimmering structure of unknown origin.

entries.zh: 该行星拥有一处极佳的地热点，提供了能量以及研究机会。
entries.en: This planet has an exceptional geothermal site that provides both energy and research opportunities.

entries.zh: 殖民地得到了这些外星远古隐形阵列的帮助。敌人难以进攻，殖民地可以感到更加安全。
entries.en: This colony benefits from the presence of an ancient alien cloaking array. It will not be easy for enemies to attack. The colonists can feel safe here.

entries.zh: 行星上的沙子到处都含有高浓度的泽珞。甚至有可能与之交流。
entries.en: The sands on this planet have high concentrations of Zro present throughout. It is possible to communicate with them.

entries.zh: 在环境改造的极热中锻造，这些巨大而坚硬的山脉是丰富的资源矿床。
entries.en: Forged in the extreme heats of terraforming, these vast unyielding mountains serve as rich resource deposits.

entries.zh: 岩浆流在这里形成了深层富矿隧道。这些高温管道中存在着有利可图的采矿机会。
entries.en: Magma flows forged deep, mineral-rich tunnels here. These pyroducts present lucrative mining opportunities.

entries.zh: 在这里的自然环境中水触手可得，使本地动物群的繁育率很高。
entries.en: Water is readily available in the natural environment here, giving rise to remarkably high native fauna breeding rates.

entries.zh: 空气中的高浓度易爆微粒让这颗行星的大气高度易燃。
entries.en: Airborne concentrations of volatile motes make this planet's atmosphere highly combustible.

entries.zh: 环境改造引起了行星深处丰富的气体和合金沉积物之间的反应，使星球表面留下了迷人的蓝色熔岩。
entries.en: The terraforming process has caused a reaction between rich gas and alloy deposits deep within the planet, leaving the surface of the world with mesmerizing blue lava.

entries.zh: 该行星上有大量的晶体生长着，可以加以开发利用。
entries.en: There is an abundance of crystalline growths on this planet that can be harvested for use.

entries.zh: 这种独特植物栖息于超酸性沼泽中，其在进食后会分泌出异星天然气。
entries.en: Super acidic bogs are home to a unique species of flora that secretes exotic gas as it feeds.

entries.zh: 一个怪异的间歇泉坍缩成了一汪液态的暗物质。
entries.en: A strange geyser has collapsed into a pool of liquid dark matter.

entries.zh: 轨道太空垃圾对穿梭机航行造成危险，若落入行星大气层还会威胁到地表建筑。
entries.en: Orbiting space debris poses dangers for shuttle access and surface structures when falling into the planet's atmosphere.

entries.zh: 暗物质饱和增强了他们的身体，现在他们每隔一段时间就要排出微量的非重子粒子，但预期寿命会更快地耗尽。
entries.en: Their bodies enhanced following saturation in Dark Matter, they now vent trace amounts of non-baryonic particles at regular intervals but will burn through their expected lifespan more quickly.

entries.zh: 实验引发的不幸反应剧烈地改变了该物种的生理特征。
entries.en: Unfortunate reactions to experimentation drastically altered this species' physiology.

entries.zh: 在长时间暴露到调整意识细菌后，该生物的消化系统产生了能促进个体间心灵感应交流的灵能益生菌。
entries.en: After long-term exposure to mind-altering bacteria, this species' digestive system produces psionic probiotics that promote telepathic communication between affected individuals.

entries.zh: 与灵能沙子沟通时，$job_sand_whisperer_plural$能从中收集少量的泽珞。
entries.en: When communicating with the psionic sands, $job_sand_whisperer_plural$ can collect a small amount of Zro from them.

entries.zh: 与灵能沙子沟通时，$job_sand_caretaker_plural$能从中收集少量的泽珞。
entries.en: When communicating with the psionic sands, $job_sand_caretaker_plural$ can collect a small amount of Zro from them.

entries.zh: 轨道太空垃圾定期进入行星的大气层。在进入时没被被烧掉的部分都可以进行回收利用。
entries.en: Orbital space junk periodically enters this planet's atmosphere. Whatever doesn't burn up on entry can be collected and recycled.

entries.zh: 以一种罕见的酶为基础的镇静剂可以触发强化冻眠，大幅度提升有机物种在长距离太空旅行中的耐受力。
entries.en: Sedatives based on a rare enzyme enable enhanced cryosleep, greatly improving organic species' tolerance of long-distance space travel.

entries.zh: 这些强力的免疫强化剂让疾病成为历史，有机人口得意获得更久、更健康。可能导致严重副作用。
entries.en: These powerful immunology boosters make disease a thing of the past, allowing organic populations to live fuller, healthier lives. May cause serious side effects.

entries.zh: 有机人口强制迁移花费
一大块磁化的太空垃圾，包含了废金属、卫星残骸和被捕获的巨型结构部件。
entries.en: A large body of magnetized space junk composed of scrap metal, satellite remnants, and recaptured megastructure parts.
